headline: Samsung Electronics is 26.7% of the Korean stock market
facts: Samsung Electronics is 26.7% of Korea's entire stock market (KOSPI + KOSDAQ) by market cap.
The two largest — Samsung Electronics and SK hynix — are 47.2% of the market between them.
The top 10 stocks are 59.9% of total market value; the top 57 are about 80%.
KOSPI holds 92.8% of market value across 942 issues; KOSDAQ 7.2% across 1822.
source: Korea Exchange OPEN API (KOSPI + KOSDAQ daily), market cap by issue
caveat: Ratios only — scale-invariant, independent of the price level. Latest trading day.
